body.content: Exploration: The optimal packing of 13 points to maximize the minimum triangle area is likely related to evenly distributing points, but the boundary points will inevitably create small triangles. A 4x4 grid minus 3 points might be heuristically worse than a structured non-linear approach. Need to computationally optimize the coordinates.
body.why_keep_this: To explore non-Cartesian geometries like circular packing projected into the square.
